en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad intersection lined with ornate late‑19th‑century / early‑20th‑century buildings. On the right is a prominent corner building with elaborate façades, bay windows, dormers, and a steep tiled roof with small towers. Awnings cover shopfronts at street level; one bears partially legible writing. Leafless trees line the sidewalks, and several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. A decorative cast‑iron streetlamp stands in the center foreground, and horse‑drawn vehicles or early carriages are visible further down the street.
